description: This file implements the GStreamerMSEMediaPlayerClient class, which manages media playback, source attachment, seeking, and interaction with a media backend in a GStreamer-based media player for Media Source Extensions (MSE). It includes methods for controlling playback, handling media data, managing sources, and processing playback state changes.

classes.name: GStreamerMSEMediaPlayerClient
classes.description: Main class managing media playback, source attachment, seeking, and interaction with the media backend in a GStreamer-based MSE player.

classes.name: BufferPuller
classes.description: Handles requesting and pulling media buffer samples from the GStreamer sink element.

classes.name: HaveDataMessage
classes.description: Message class for handling media data availability notifications.

classes.name: PullBufferMessage
classes.description: Message class for requesting and processing buffer pulls from the sink.

classes.name: PlaybackStateMessage
classes.description: Message class for handling playback state changes.

classes.name: QosMessage
classes.description: Message class for handling QoS updates.

classes.name: BufferUnderflowMessage
classes.description: Message class for handling buffer underflow events.

methods.name: stopStreaming
methods.description: Stops streaming and associated buffer pullers.

methods.name: destroyClientBackend
methods.description: Resets the client backend, effectively destroying the media pipeline.

methods.name: notifyDuration
methods.description: Posts a message to update the media duration.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Posts a message to update the current playback position.

methods.name: notifyNativeSize
methods.description: Placeholder for native size notification (empty implementation).

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Placeholder for network state notification (empty implementation).

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Posts a message to update playback state.

methods.name: notifyVideoData
methods.description: Placeholder for video data notification (empty implementation).

methods.name: notifyAudioData
methods.description: Placeholder for audio data notification (empty implementation).

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Posts a message indicating need for more media data.

methods.name: notifyCancelNeedMediaData
methods.description: Placeholder for cancel media data request notification.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Posts a message with QoS information.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Posts a message indicating buffer underflow.

methods.name: getPositionDo
methods.description: Retrieves current position from backend and updates internal state.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Calls getPositionDo in the event loop and returns the current position.

methods.name: createBackend
methods.description: Creates the media backend and loads a test URL.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Triggers playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback.

methods.name: notifySourceStartedSeeking
methods.description: Handles source seeking start notification.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Performs a seek operation to a specified position.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the player, initializing buffer pullers.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from the player.

methods.name: startPullingDataIfSeekFinished
methods.description: Starts data pulling if seek operation has finished.

methods.name: handlePlaybackStateChange
methods.description: Handles changes in playback state and updates sources accordingly.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video display rectangle based on a string input.

methods.name: getVideoRectangle
methods.description: Returns the current video rectangle as a string.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Requests rendering a frame from the backend.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the playback volume.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the audio.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Returns the mute state.

methods.name: setAudioStreamsInfo
methods.description: Sets the number of audio streams and whether the session is audio-only.

methods.name: setVideoStreamsInfo
methods.description: Sets the number of video streams and whether the session is video-only.

methods.name: areAllStreamsAttached
methods.description: Checks if all expected streams are attached.

methods.name: requestPullBuffer
methods.description: Requests buffer data for a specific stream.

methods.name: handleQos
methods.description: Handles QoS updates for a source.

methods.name: handleBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Handles buffer underflow events for a source.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to the pipeline, thread-safe.
